  ?street wdt:[property:located in the administrative territorial entity]* wd:[entity:Berlin] .
  ?street rdfs:label ?name .
  FILTER(LANG(?name) = "de")
}
GROUP BY ?name
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?street) > 1)
ORDER BY DESC(?count) ?name
